summary: Stored Members[Value].IsDefault = false on Access.TextBox/ComboBox/ListBox even though those types declare DefaultMemberName=Value; callers reading TypeInfo.Members directly see inconsistent default-member metadata.
resolution: Parameterized DataBoundControlMembers(bool valueIsDefault) so the three data-bound subtypes pass valueIsDefault: true at compose time, marking the stored Value with IsDefault=true. Tightened ValidateRegistryAtConstruction with an invariant: when DefaultMemberName names a member declared directly on the same type, the direct member's IsDefault flag must be true. Updated the test catalog's TextBox/ComboBox/ListBox Value entries from false to true. Applied in-place after the workflow's max-2-retries verification cap.

summary: Comments and XML docs still described the removed Access.DataBoundControl intermediate type.
resolution: Rewrote the Access section banner comment in TypeLibraryRegistry.cs to describe the composition model. Updated the Access.Control summary to say data-bound members are composed into TextBox/ComboBox/ListBox via the private helper. Updated the ITypeLibraryRegistry.cs DefaultMemberName example to reference DAO.Recordset.Fields and to document the new direct-member IsDefault invariant. Applied in-place after the workflow's max-2-retries verification cap.
